actions.joint_pos.preserve_order: Decision D1: joints are ordered by the depth-first walk of the kinematic tree, which needs preserve_order set. Main leaves it False and accepts PhysX's breadth-first order, which no other engine reproduces.
actions.joint_pos.scale: Same 29 numbers, keyed per joint instead of by the sixteen actuator-group patterns main inherits from the Isaac Lab asset module. Taken from RobotSpec.joint_properties so the task needs no engine import; verified equal for every joint.
curriculum: Main declares an empty container; the task declares no curriculum terms.
